patch_description: Replace the final stochastic soft-force polishing with explicit contact-aware moves. The objective is nonsmooth: only shortest-pair and diameter-pair memberships matter locally. This edit forms separate near-minimum and near-maximum active sets, alternates a shortest-contact repulsion move with a diameter-contact contraction move, and retains small random perturbations solely for contact-graph exchanges. Every move remains subject to strict exact-ratio acceptance, so this cannot degrade the best retained configuration while providing more decisive local refinement than a single force whose competing contacts can cancel.
